facts.text: Benedict wants his money back, so dinner on the terrace is on a budget. Twelve people, one pot of pasta, I eat first.
facts.why: Printed in quote marks as Rusty's words, but it is not a line from the film. The money plot is real (Benedict wants the $160 million back plus interest). I could not open a quote page for this pass (the search tool was out of budget), so there is no quote source.
facts.fix: Benedict wants his money back, so dinner is on a budget. One pot of pasta, twelve people, and I serve myself first.
